increment_note: Living maintenance spec for the draw.io integration: it is the starting point for spec changes, not a record of a past implementation. Requirements 1-8 are the behaviour contract (change them, then follow with the implementation -- procedure in design.md). Requirements 9-11 are what the spec itself must satisfy. Restructured 2026-08-05 on user feedback: dropped what is more reliably read from the code (signatures, file tree, traceability table, per-test coverage enumeration) and kept the facts that took real research plus the reasons behind unusual choices. PRs #11633 / #11524 are referenced, not the subject.
